shape3=[ [9,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,9], [3,3,1,1,1,1,1,3,3], [9,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,9] ]
for dr,row in enumerate(shape3):
    for dc,val in enumerate(row):
        if val==3: out[21+dr][3+dc]=5
# 1 square -> 1-filled band with 8 sides, bottom aligned.
for r in range(27,29):
    for c in range(13,15): out[r][c]=8
import json
print(json.dumps(out))
